definition.name: Exact production Write and timeout references with old counterexamples

steps.name: Check exact projection and strict counterexample reader
Authenticate one official reference compiler
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-write-reference-tools"
test ! -e "$out"
mkdir "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "7226736c2339719cda28fbf3a54d71aa63bcefe376e98cef00034268dab24840  $out/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/go.tar.gz" -C "$out"
echo "$out/go/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Execute original failures and corrected Write and timeout controls
Retain bounded source and actual method reference evidence

reviewReason: Preserve original Write controls and pinned compiler; add the provider-bound timeout source reference and retain its separate receipt without relaxing original limits.
